Introduction

The assignments from Week 5 (Data Cleaning) and Week 6 (Data Wrangling) should be completed and submitted together as one combined assignment. Please organize your work into a single reproducible report using R Markdown or Quarto, including the required code, tables, figures, and written interpretations from both weeks. Your final submission should clearly include:
Week 5: data cleaning, missing-value handling, outliner processing, and cleaned BMI/BP variables.
Week 6: repeated-measure data wrangling, within-person BP variability, and the comparison of BP classification using different measurement strategies.
A short conclusion summarizing the main findings and what you learned from the two-week workflow.

  1. Clean BMI outliers using the predefined rule below.
    Part A1: clean ONE variable (BMI) step by step
    Potential-outlier rule used in this lab:
  1. outside a prespecified plausible range
  2. outside Q1 - 1.5IQR or Q3 + 1.5IQR
  3. absolute MAD-based robust z-score > 3.5
    A value is flagged if ANY of the three conditions is true.
#常見的 BMI 紀錄錯誤範圍
BMI_LO <- 10
BMI_HI <- 80

bmi_x <- bmx$bmxbmi

# Plausible-range rule, outliner 回傳 TRUE
bmi_range_flag <- bmi_x < BMI_LO | bmi_x > BMI_HI

# IQR rule
bmi_q <- quantile(bmi_x,
                  probs = c(0.25, 0.75), #這裡只要求算 Q1, Q3 所以後面要寫bmi_q[1] & [2]
                  na.rm = TRUE,
                  names = FALSE) #如果沒加，會回傳 "25%", "75%"
bmi_iqr <- bmi_q[2] - bmi_q[1]
bmi_lo_iqr <- bmi_q[1] - 1.5 * bmi_iqr
bmi_hi_iqr <- bmi_q[2] + 1.5 * bmi_iqr
bmi_iqr_flag <- bmi_x < bmi_lo_iqr | bmi_x > bmi_hi_iqr #額外多一個變量備份判斷結果

# MAD-based robust z-score
bmi_med <- median(bmi_x, na.rm = TRUE)
bmi_mad_raw <- mad(bmi_x, center = bmi_med, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE)

if (is.na(bmi_mad_raw) || bmi_mad_raw == 0) {
  bmi_mad_flag <- rep(FALSE, length(bmi_x))
} else {
  bmi_robust_z <- abs(bmi_x - bmi_med) / (1.4826 * bmi_mad_raw)
  bmi_mad_flag <- bmi_robust_z > 3.5
}


# Combine the three rules
bmi_flag <- !is.na(bmi_x) &
  (bmi_range_flag | bmi_iqr_flag | bmi_mad_flag)

bmi_clean <- bmx %>%
  transmute(
    seqn,
    bmi_raw = bmxbmi,
    bmi_flag = bmi_flag,
    bmi_clean = if_else(bmi_flag, NA_real_, bmi_raw)
  )

dat_bmi <- demo_adult %>%
  left_join(bmi_clean, by = "seqn")

# Check how many BMI values were flagged
sum(bmi_clean$bmi_flag)
## [1] 189
bmi_clean %>%
  filter(bmi_flag) %>%
  arrange(desc(bmi_raw))

  1. Compare the number and proportion of missing BMI values before and after cleaning.
#Make a table
miss_bmi <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    stage = "Before",
    variable = "BMI",
    n_missing = sum(is.na(dat_bmi$bmi_raw)),
    n_total = nrow(dat_bmi)
  ),
  tibble(
    stage = "After",
    variable = "BMI",
    n_missing = sum(is.na(dat_bmi$bmi_clean)),
    n_total = nrow(dat_bmi)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_missing = n_missing / n_total,
    stage = factor(stage, levels = c("Before", "After"))
  )

#geom_bar() 預設會自己 count observations
p_miss_bmi <- ggplot(miss_bmi,
                     aes(x = variable, y = p_missing, fill = stage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(percent(p_missing, accuracy = 0.1),
                       "\n(", n_missing, "/", n_total, ")")),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.2, size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "BMI missingness before vs after cleaning",
       x = NULL, y = "Missing rate", fill = "Stage") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

Part B: Homework

I. Identify the three systolic (SBP) and three diastolic (DBP) blood-pressure columns.

# 擷取 3 次 SBP 與 3 次 DBP 變數名稱
# coding book 裡為 BPXOSY1~3 和 BPXODI1~3
# 以 bpxosy 或 bpxosy 開頭，接數字 1 到 3 結尾
sbp_cols <- names(bpx)[str_detect(names(bpx), "^bpxosy[1-3]$")] 
dbp_cols <- names(bpx)[str_detect(names(bpx), "^bpxodi[1-3]$")]

print(sbp_cols)
## [1] "bpxosy1" "bpxosy2" "bpxosy3"
print(dbp_cols)
## [1] "bpxodi1" "bpxodi2" "bpxodi3"
  1. Create the raw participant-level mean SBP from the three original SBP readings.
# 計算每位受試者原始 3 次測量的 SBP 平均值
# rowMeans(..., na.rm = TRUE) 在所有讀數皆為 NA 時會回傳 NaN，因此轉換為 NA_real_
# R 規則：NA：預設為邏輯值（logical）
# NA_real_：雙精度浮點數值（numeric / double）
bpx_raw <- bpx %>%
  mutate(
    sbp_raw_mean = rowMeans(select(., all_of(sbp_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    sbp_raw_mean = if_else(is.nan(sbp_raw_mean), NA_real_, sbp_raw_mean),
    dbp_raw_mean = rowMeans(select(., all_of(dbp_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    dbp_raw_mean = if_else(is.nan(dbp_raw_mean), NA_real_, dbp_raw_mean)
  )
  1. Clean each individual SBP and DBP reading before calculating the participant-level means.
clean_reading <- function(x, lo_bound, hi_bound) {
  # 規則 1: 生理邊界
  flag_range <- x < lo_bound | x > hi_bound
  
  # 規則 2: IQR 圍欄
  q <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  iqr_val <- q[2] - q[1]
  flag_iqr <- x < (q[1] - 1.5 * iqr_val) | x > (q[2] + 1.5 * iqr_val)
  
  # 規則 3: MAD 穩健 z 分數
  med_val <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_val <- mad(x, center = med_val, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(mad_val) || mad_val == 0) {
    flag_mad <- rep(FALSE, length(x))
  } 
  else {
    flag_mad <- (abs(x - med_val) / (1.4826 * mad_val)) > 3.5
  }
  
  # 綜合判定：符合任一條件即標記為異常並設為 NA
  flag <- !is.na(x) & (flag_range | flag_iqr | flag_mad)
  if_else(flag, NA_real_, x)
}

# 逐一清理每次測量：SBP (70-260 mmHg)、DBP (40-150 mmHg)
bpx_cleaned_readings <- bpx %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(sbp_cols), ~ clean_reading(.x, lo_bound = 70, hi_bound = 260), .names = "{.col}_clean"),
    across(all_of(dbp_cols), ~ clean_reading(.x, lo_bound = 40, hi_bound = 150), .names = "{.col}_clean")
  )

sbp_clean_cols <- paste0(sbp_cols, "_clean")
dbp_clean_cols <- paste0(dbp_cols, "_clean")
  1. Calculate cleaned mean SBP and mean DBP.
# 計算每次測量清理後的受試者層級平均值
bpx_clean <- bpx_cleaned_readings %>%
  mutate(
    sbp_clean_mean = rowMeans(select(., all_of(sbp_clean_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    sbp_clean_mean = if_else(is.nan(sbp_clean_mean), NA_real_, sbp_clean_mean),
    dbp_clean_mean = rowMeans(select(., all_of(dbp_clean_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    dbp_clean_mean = if_else(is.nan(dbp_clean_mean), NA_real_, dbp_clean_mean)
  )

V. Build the final cleaned analysis dataset for adults aged >=20 years.

# 整合 demo_adult (>=20歲)、清理後的 BMI 以及清理後的血壓資料
analysis_df <- demo_adult %>%
  left_join(bmi_clean %>% select(seqn, bmi_raw, bmi_clean, bmi_flag), by = "seqn") %>%
  left_join(
    bpx_raw %>% select(seqn, sbp_raw_mean, dbp_raw_mean), by = "seqn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    bpx_clean %>% select(seqn, all_of(sbp_clean_cols), all_of(dbp_clean_cols), sbp_clean_mean, dbp_clean_mean),
    by = "seqn"
  )

V. Examine within-person SBP change from Trial 1 to Trial 3.

sbp_change <- bp_long %>%
  filter(measure == "SBP") %>%
  select(seqn, trial, value) %>%
  mutate(trial = paste0("trial", trial)) %>% 
  #「新增或修改現有的欄位」，同時保留資料表原本的所有其他欄位。
  pivot_wider(names_from = trial, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_31 = trial3 - trial1, #利用另外一個參數把連續資料分組
    change_direction = case_when(
      is.na(delta_31) ~ NA_character_,
      delta_31 < 0 ~ "Trial 3 lower",
      delta_31 > 0 ~ "Trial 3 higher",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

  group_by(seqn, measure) %>%
  summarise(

    mean_bp = ifelse(n_readings > 0,
                     mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    range_bp = ifelse(n_readings >= 2,
                      max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                      NA_real_),
    sd_bp = ifelse(n_readings >= 2,
                   sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),

  )

    p90_range = quantile(range_bp, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_sd = median(sd_bp, na.rm = TRUE),

  1. Class discussion: population-level stability is not the same as individual-level stability.

Compare the three-trial boxplots, the Trial 3 - Trial 1 histogram, and the repeated-measure line plot based on the raw repeated BP readings.
• Do the overall trial distributions look similar?

• Do most individuals also have nearly identical readings?

• How might extreme or unusual readings affect within-person change and variability?

個人回顧：

  1. 是的，從三次測量的盒鬚圖與摘要表中可以發現，他們的中位數、 IQR 和平均值幾乎完全一樣，外觀整體呈現高度相似。例：SBP 中位數落在 120~121 mmHg 之間，平均值也僅相差 0.4。
  2. 並不是，從 3 - 1 相減的直方圖和 spaghetti plot （第七題）可以看到雖然群體平均變化並不大。但是單一個體的起伏卻有所差異，有些呈現上凸、下凹或斜線，其中有不少受試者自己的波動超過 10。
  3. 因為個體的變異度和單次的差僅依賴每人 3 次測量，一但有一次測驗出現極端值，就可能大幅度影響平均值或全距。而這樣的差異足以影響受測者的臨床分組，也顯現先前 Week 5 的讀數數據清理重要性。

Part B: Homework

I. Rebuild the cleaned long-format BP dataset, then create Trial 1, mean BP, and within-person variability summaries.

# 1. 取得清理後的 repeated BP 欄位名稱
sbp_clean_cols <- paste0(sbp_cols, "_clean")
dbp_clean_cols <- paste0(dbp_cols, "_clean")

# 2. 將成人受試者的清理後血壓資料轉為長格式 (long format)
bp_clean_long <- bpx_clean %>%
  semi_join(demo_adult %>% select(seqn), by = "seqn") %>%
  select(seqn, all_of(c(sbp_clean_cols, dbp_clean_cols))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -seqn,
    names_to = c("measure", "trial"),
    names_pattern = "^bpxo?(sy|di)([1-3])_clean$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = recode(measure, "sy" = "SBP", "di" = "DBP"),
    trial = as.integer(trial),
    trial_f = factor(trial, levels = 1:3, labels = c("Trial 1", "Trial 2", "Trial 3"))
  )

# 3. 提取 Trial 1 測量值
trial1_bp <- bp_clean_long %>%
  filter(trial == 1) %>%
  select(seqn, measure, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = value, names_prefix = "trial1_")

# 4. 計算個體層級平均值 (Mean BP)
mean_bp <- bp_clean_long %>%
  group_by(seqn, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = if_else(sum(!is.na(value)) > 0, mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = mean_val, names_prefix = "mean_")

# 5. 計算個體內變異度 (Within-person variability: SD 與 Range)
var_bp <- bp_clean_long %>%
  group_by(seqn, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    sd_val = if_else(sum(!is.na(value)) >= 2, sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    range_val = if_else(sum(!is.na(value)) >= 2, max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measure,
    values_from = c(sd_val, range_val),
    names_glue = "{measure}_{.value}"
  )
## Warning: There were 1140 warnings in `summarise()`.
## The first warning was:
## ℹ In argument: `range_val = if_else(...)`.
## ℹ In group 37: `seqn = 130402`, `measure = "DBP"`.
## Caused by warning in `max()`:
## ! no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
## ℹ Run `dplyr::last_dplyr_warnings()` to see the 1139 remaining warnings.
# 6. 整合為受試者層級的分析資料集
bp_summary <- trial1_bp %>%
  left_join(mean_bp, by = "seqn") %>%
  left_join(var_bp, by = "seqn")

glimpse(bp_summary)

  1. Create four BP categories for Trial 1 and for the repeated-measure mean.
# 定義血壓分級函數（遵循階層順序：由最高等級開始判定）
# 規則：以及清除未分類
# - Normal: SBP < 120 & DBP < 80
# - Elevated: SBP 120-129 & DBP < 80
# - Stage 1: SBP 130-139 | DBP 80-89
# - Stage 2: SBP >= 140 | DBP >= 90
classify_bp <- function(sbp, dbp) {
  case_when(
    is.na(sbp) | is.na(dbp) ~ NA_character_,
    sbp >= 140 | dbp >= 90   ~ "Stage 2",
    sbp >= 130 | dbp >= 80   ~ "Stage 1",
    sbp >= 120 & dbp < 80    ~ "Elevated",
    sbp < 120  & dbp < 80    ~ "Normal",
    TRUE                     ~ NA_character_
  )
}

bp_levels <- c("Normal", "Elevated", "Stage 1", "Stage 2")

bp_classified <- bp_summary %>%
  mutate(
    cat_trial1 = factor(classify_bp(trial1_SBP, trial1_DBP), levels = bp_levels),
    cat_mean   = factor(classify_bp(mean_SBP, mean_DBP), levels = bp_levels)
  )

# 檢視兩策略下的各類別樣本數
bp_classified %>% count(cat_trial1)

  1. Calculate the overall reclassification proportion and create a cross-tabulation.
# 篩選兩項分類策略皆非缺失之受試者
reclass_df <- bp_classified %>%
  filter(!is.na(cat_trial1) & !is.na(cat_mean)) %>%
  mutate(is_reclassified = cat_trial1 != cat_mean)

# 計算整體重新分類比例
reclass_summary <- reclass_df %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_reclassified = sum(is_reclassified),
    reclass_prop = mean(is_reclassified)
  )
print(reclass_summary)

  1. Visualize the classification changes as a heatmap.
# 整理交叉分類頻率與比例以繪製熱圖 (Heatmap)
heatmap_df <- reclass_df %>%
  count(cat_trial1, cat_mean) %>% # 計算「第一次量測血壓分類（cat_trial1）」與「三次平均血壓分類（cat_mean）」的交叉組合人數
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n), #轉換百分比
    is_diagonal = cat_trial1 == cat_mean #標記對角(兩次結果一樣，可做為後續分析標記點)
  )

p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = cat_mean, y = cat_trial1, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), ")")),
            size = 3.8) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of Blood Pressure Reclassification",
    subtitle = "Comparing Trial 1 alone versus 3-Trial mean (Adults aged >= 20)",
    x = "Mean BP Category",
    y = "Trial 1 BP Category",
    fill = "Participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

print(p_heatmap)

ggsave("outputs/week6_bp_reclassification_heatmap.png", p_heatmap,
       width = 7, height = 6, bg = "white")

V.Test the descriptive hypothesis that larger within-person variability leads to more reclassification.

# 使用 ntile(x, 3) 依受試者層級的 SBP 變異度 (標準差) 分為三等分 (Tertiles)
variability_reclass <- reclass_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(SBP_sd_val)) %>% #排除遺失值
  mutate(
    sd_tertile = ntile(SBP_sd_val, 3),
    variability_group = factor( #轉 factor
      sd_tertile,
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c("Low Variability", "Moderate Variability", "High Variability")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(variability_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(), #總人數
    n_reclassified = sum(is_reclassified), #重新分組累進
    reclass_rate = mean(is_reclassified), #重新分組比例
    mean_sd = mean(SBP_sd_val, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#先用表格輸出
knitr::kable(
  variability_reclass,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Reclassification Rate by Within-Person SBP Variability Group"
)

# 繪製各變異度組別之重新分類比例圖（這裡是用查的）去找 library
p_reclass_var <- ggplot(variability_reclass, aes(x = variability_group, y = reclass_rate, fill = variability_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(reclass_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
    vjust = -0.3, size = 4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel2") +
  labs(
    title = "Reclassification Rate by Within-Person SBP Variability",
    x = "SBP Variability Tertile (Within-Person SD)",
    y = "Reclassification Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_reclass_var)

ggsave("outputs/week6_reclassification_by_variability.png", p_reclass_var,
       width = 6, height = 5, bg = "white")

VI.Write a brief conclusion.

Conclusion / 分析結論：
一、第四題繪製的熱圖(Heatmap of Blood pressure Reclassification)：
可以觀察到由左下向右上有一個特別比較深的鞋直線，他是代表單次測量跟三次測量。 Normal, Elevated, Stage1, Stage2 兩種測量方式一致的比例分別為 40.7%, 9.8%, 18.1%, 14.5%。 在這張圖表中，這個斜直線顏色相對較深顯現出大多數人的血壓分級在兩種測驗方式分類下是一樣的。
對角線之外可分為以上的高估與以下的低估：
首先，以上的高估可能是因為緊張使得單次測量的血壓值偏高。單次量測較高但實際平均較低者，佔全部的11.3%。 再者，以下的低估則可能會是單次測量的偽陰性。倘若只看第一次測量結果則可能會忽略的個體，佔全部的5.7%。
可以直觀發現高估者較低估者多，因此如果僅取一次測驗則可能會出現較多類似「白袍高血壓」的狀況。

二、第五題的比例長條圖
X-axis: 所有受試者依照收縮壓變異度 (Within-Person SD) 分成 Low, Moderate, High
Y-axis: 重新分類的比例 -> 因為血壓不穩定導致三次平均結果出現落差、需要重新歸類的比例
觀察圖表之後可以發現有明顯的「遞增」趨勢，隨著更高的變異度有更高的重新歸類比例。因此可以顯現對於血壓本身比較不穩定的患者，如果只依靠單一次的血壓測量會有將近 30 的機率會被錯誤分級。因此，對於變異比較大的族群相對更需要多次重複測量、監測才能取得貼近真實的平均值，進一步避免誤診（偽陽性）或是漏診（偽陰性）。

參考資料：白袍高血壓
臺北市立聯合醫院–心臟血管科 https://tpech.gov.taipei/mp109171/News_Content.aspx?n=BAE150C13831E11C&sms=F2D5808A410BD35A&s=3A0AD121740119E4

總結：

在這兩週的實作課程中我們針對數據中 20 歲以上的成年人進行 BMI and BP 的資料清理與重複測量分析：
要先將異常值清理以及針對缺失值檢核並踢除極端值，在處理資料前的 QC 可以減少後續進行資料分析的時候產生偏誤的可能性。除此之外，也可以觀察到 BMI and avg(BP) 之間有微微的正相關關係。
爾後可以根據前面第六週的結論發現，整體數據的穩定並無法代表單一數據的趨勢。利用盒狀圖和 spaghetti plot 兩者便能清楚的視覺化看到兩個不同視角下的差異。
最後，我還學到在面對重複測量的資料時，必須要先針對「單次原始數據」進行異常值 QC ，才可以進行下一步。否則往後的平均值都可能受到這些異常個體的污染。還有群體的穩定度（through box plot）並不能代表個體的測量穩定度（by shaphetti plot）
